title: Multilinear Extension and Product Expectations
statement: Let $P$ be a predicate on sign vectors with finite arity $m$. For each position $i\in\text{Fin}(m)$, let $A_i$ be a finite sample space with probability law $\mu_i$, and let $g_i:A_i\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation, under the independent product law, of the multilinear extension of $P$ evaluated at the values $g_i$ of the sampled coordinates equals the multilinear extension evaluated at the coordinate means $\mathbb{E}_{\mu_i}[g_i]$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a sign predicate of finite arity
Each position has a finite sample space $A_i$
A probability law $\mu_i$ on each $A_i$ is specified
A real-valued function $g_i$ on each $A_i$ is specified
